name: flaggems_special_log1p
description: Extracted from FlagGems special_log1p: elementwise torch.special.log1p over a float tensor. Reference is vendor PyTorch torch.special.log1p with no reference-side upcast (to_reference upcast defaults to False). Includes source boundary cases (x<=-1 NaN, +/-inf, small float64 values) validated NaN/Inf-tolerantly.
